content.text: The redline validated. Submitting the finding.

input.quote: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the \"Termination Date\").
input.rationale: Section 4.1 gives both parties a symmetrical 90-day termination right, so HDI (the vendor/host) can walk away during a renewing term, contrary to our position that the vendor has no convenience right during a committed term. Our own exit right is also worse than the playbook: 90 days' notice (only fallback-level) and, worse, Section 4.2 imposes a one-sided Termination Payment on the Company equal to 50% of trailing twelve-month Net Sales above $800,000 — an uncapped exit penalty far exceeding the fallback cap of three months' fees (fees are 30% of Net Sales under Section 3), with no reciprocal payment from HDI. The redline gives us a 30-day convenience right with refund of prepaid fees, limits HDI to end-of-term non-renewal on 90 days' notice, and deletes the Termination Payment mechanics (4.2(a)-(c)); a cap of three months' fees is offered as fallback.

proposal.summary: Give the Company a 30-day convenience termination right without penalty; limit HDI to end-of-term non-renewal on 90 days' notice; remove the Net Sales-based Termination Payment.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a Company right to terminate for convenience on 30 days' notice without penalty and limited HDI to non-renewal at the end of a term on 90 days' notice, so HDI cannot walk away mid-term. We have also deleted the Termination Payment, which is an uncapped exit penalty (50% of annual Net Sales over $800,000) payable only by us; if HDI needs some exit compensation, we can discuss a cap of no more than three months' fees.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date").
ops.newText: unless (a) the Company terminates this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to HDI, in which case HDI shall refund any prepaid fees for the period after the effective date of termination, or (b) HDI elects not to renew this Agreement effective at the end of the then-current term upon ninety (90) days' prior written notice to the Company. HDI shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during any term. Such notice shall specify the date on which this Agreement is to be terminated (the "Termination Date").

ops.oldText: (a) In the event the Company terminates this Agreement, the Company shall pay to HDI a termination payment, (the "Termination Payment") the amount of which shall be an amount equal to the aggregate Net Sales for the twelve (12) months preceding the Termination Date less $800,000, the balance of which shall be divided by two.
ops.newText: (a) No termination payment, early termination fee or other penalty shall be payable by the Company in connection with any termination or non-renewal of this Agreement, and the Company's sole payment obligation shall be for fees accrued under Section 3 for periods prior to the Termination Date.
